title: 学习目标

questions.prompt: I have changed my study strategy after the tutor's advice.

questions.answer: 我听了导师的建议后改变了学习策略。

options: 我听了导师的建议后改变了学习策略。

questions.prompt: 听句子，判断学习者有什么变化。
questions.audio: The tutor has noticed steady progress.
questions.answer: 导师注意到了稳定的进步。
questions.translation: 导师注意到了稳定的进步。
options: 导师注意到了稳定的进步。
导师建议停止所有练习。
学习者还没有开始学习。

questions.prompt: 配对学习目标中的重点词。

questions.prompt: The weekly notes show clear progress.
questions.audio: The weekly notes show clear progress.
questions.answer: 每周笔记显示出清晰的进步。

questions.audio: I will record one answer each night.

questions.answer: 我会每天晚上录一个回答。
questions.translation: 我会每天晚上录一个回答。

我会每周取消一次练习。

questions.audio: Her weekly notes show steady progress.
questions.translation: 她的每周笔记显示出稳定的进步。

turns.speaker: leo
turns.text: I have practiced every day, but my speaking still feels slow.
turns.translation: 我每天都练习，但口语仍然觉得慢。

turns.speaker: grace
turns.text: Your feedback shows clear progress; try recording one answer each night.
turns.translation: 你的反馈显示出明显进步；试试每天晚上录一个回答。

turns.speaker: leo
turns.text: That strategy is small enough to keep, even during exams.
turns.translation: 这个策略很小，即使考试期间也能坚持。
